name: Marmota
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Marmota in Gries im Sellrain!**

Discover the cozy charm of the **Alpenstuben Marmota**, where traditional Tyrolean hospitality meets modern comfort. Nestled in the picturesque village of **Gries im Sellrain**, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this family-run inn invites you to unwind in a warm, rustic atmosphere.

Indulge in authentic Tyrolean cuisine—think hearty **Kaiserschmarrn**, crispy **Speckknödel**, and fresh mountain dishes crafted with local ingredients. After a day of exploring the stunning **Sellrain Valley** or skiing on the slopes of **Achensee**, return to your cozy room and savor the tranquility of the Alps.

Whether you're seeking relaxation, adventure, or a taste of **Tirol’s** finest traditions, **Marmota** is your perfect retreat. **Willkommen in Gries im Sellrain!**
